description: Canonical rename mapping from removed / deprecated identifiers to their v1 replacements (or to null when the concept was deleted with no direct successor). cotest scanner and downstream migration tooling consume this as the single source of truth for mechanical renames. Replacement=null means there is no automatic substitution; readers / writers MUST follow the migration guidance in 'notes'.

rejection_levels.hard_reject: After replacement, the old identifier MUST NOT appear in current code or wire bytes. Current v1 parsers MUST reject the old identifier without inspecting payload shape.
rejection_levels.migration_only: Tolerated only inside offline migration / replay tools, NEVER in current v1 wire parsers. Current parsers (sync, federation, snapshot consumers, reducer) MUST reject the old identifier without inspecting payload shape; migration_tool_only entries below carry the `migration_tool_only: true` flag to make this enforceable. The 'mechanical replacement window' language has been retired — there is no in-band tolerance.
rejection_levels.compat_only: Old form retained only on explicit interop surfaces.
rejection_levels.docs_only: Old form survives in CHANGELOG / migration docs only.

parser_tier_definitions.current_parser: Sync service, federation peer, snapshot consumer, reducer, conformance test runner — anything that processes live or persisted v1 wire bytes. MUST treat every entry in this file as forbidden in input; MUST NOT do payload-shape disambiguation; reject with the schema's standard unknown_kind / unknown_field / schema_violation error.
parser_tier_definitions.migration_tool: Offline batch tool that reads pre-v1 / pre-inversion bytes and rewrites them to canonical v1 form. May consult migration_tool_only entries (those carrying the explicit flag) and apply their disambiguation_payload_shape rule. MUST NOT be embedded in a real-time parser surface (no inline transform; no 'auto-accept legacy and quietly rewrite').

migration_group_definitions.agent_session_namespace_collapse: Superseded by agent_applet_interop_session_rename: the agent capability action namespace and the agent/applet session event kinds now both use the interop_session form.
migration_group_definitions.typed_id_prefix_unabbreviation: Abbreviated typed-id prefixes expanded to full snake_case kind. Single rule: ck:<abbrev>: → ck:<full_kind>: (9 entries).
migration_group_definitions.realm_lifecycle_segment_realignment: Realm lifecycle capability actions flattened from 4 segments (cx.realm.lifecycle.<verb>) to 3 segments (cx.realm.<verb>) to match the corresponding event kind (4 entries). target_event_kinds preserved.
migration_group_definitions.did_id_suffix: Protocol responsibility subjects use the _id suffix even when the value is a DID. actor_did / principal_did / subject_did renamed to actor_id / principal_id / subject_id, and the bare wire fields `actor` (policy check request, bound_to, capability vector request; MIMI consent update request) and `requester` (MIMI consent request) renamed to actor_id / requester_id (6 entries).
migration_group_definitions.agent_key_imperative_verbs: Event kind verbs use imperative action names, not past participles. cx.agent.key.{authorized,revoked,rotated} → cx.agent.key.{authorize,revoke,rotate} (3 entries).
migration_group_definitions.device_imperative_verbs: Same rule as agent_key_imperative_verbs but for device key events (2 entries).
migration_group_definitions.crdt_lattice_snake_case: CRDT lattice enum values use snake_case (5 entries).
migration_group_definitions.hash_to_digest_vocabulary: Wire fields carrying hash output bytes use _digest with self-describing <alg>:<hex>; algorithm selectors use _algorithm; tree roots use _root. _hash is forbidden as wire field-name suffix (~50 entries).
migration_group_definitions.signature_algorithm_vocabulary: Signature and key algorithm selector fields use the full _algorithm suffix; JOSE/JWK nested headers may still use standard alg.
migration_group_definitions.blob_reference_naming: Blob references use <noun>_blob_ref when the role noun is not already blob.
migration_group_definitions.full_word_field_names: Protocol wire fields use full nouns for signature/public_key/base64url material rather than sig/pubkey/b64 abbreviations.
migration_group_definitions.status_axis_timestamp: Status-axis transition timestamps use status_changed_at instead of a bare changed_at.
migration_group_definitions.claim_kind_discriminator: Closed protocol-level claim discriminators use claim_kind; external credential taxonomy selectors may continue to use claim_type.
migration_group_definitions.duration_iso8601: Human-readable policy duration wire strings use ISO 8601 (^P...) as the single v1 format; the self-invented compact ^[0-9]+(ms|s|m|h|d)$ mini-DSL is forbidden. Machine timing fields keep integer _ms / _seconds. See common-fields.md §3.0.2.
migration_group_definitions.frank_to_franking_proof_noun: Moderation franking objects use the full franking_proof noun (4 entries).
migration_group_definitions.verb_noun_bridge_collapse: Capability actions converged back to noun form matching their target event kind. The earlier verb-form action names (.manage / .modify / create_*) are forbidden; new IAM tools can use the event kind string verbatim as the action token. 6 entries; v3 (2026-05-24). See authz/capabilities.md §5.0a.
migration_group_definitions.grant_constraint_single_kind_ids: Grant constraint fields that carry one concrete protocol identifier kind use `_ids`; `_refs` remains reserved for causal/proof/schema/content-addressed or polymorphic reference material.
migration_group_definitions.metadata_encryption_floor_rename: Wire field metadata_encryption_profile renamed to metadata_encryption_floor.
migration_group_definitions.key_backup_kdf_hash_to_digest_algorithm: Key backup KDF parameter algorithm selectors use digest_algorithm; hash is reserved for actual digest material and internal JSON Schema defs.
migration_group_definitions.brand_namespace_cx_to_ck: Wire/brand namespace renamed from the legacy `contrix` brand to `cokret`. Every wire token prefix `cx.` becomes `ck.` and every typed-id prefix `cx:` becomes `ck:` across operation_id, event_kind, schema_id, capability action, id_kind, error code, vector id, and profile id. The bare brand strings `contrix` / `Contrix` and the token prefixes `cx.` / `cx:` are hard_reject on the current wire and in current identifiers (allowed only in CHANGELOG / migration docs / negative drift fixtures). HTTP paths additionally moved to the versionless trust-circle namespace `/_cokret/<segment>/...` (see sync/service-http-binding.md §2.1); the legacy flat paths and `/api/v1` / `/cokret/v1` prefixes are recorded in removed-operation-ids.json. Mechanical, single design decision; the entries below are representative seals, the rule applies to the whole token space.
migration_group_definitions.operation_id_trust_surface_segment: Scheme B: operation_id now encodes its trust-surface classifier as the mandatory leading segment (ck.<surface>.<resource>.<action>, surface in {self,peer,edge,root,find,gate,open}), matching the HTTP path's first segment 1:1. 108 operations gain the surface prefix; peer.* were already compliant and ck.server.describe (pre-auth root meta, no surface segment) is the sole exception. grpc service names gain the PascalCase surface prefix and mq topics the lowercase surface segment in lockstep. Single design decision; entries are mechanical applications.
migration_group_definitions.agent_applet_interop_session_rename: Agent and applet session surfaces renamed from the ambiguous `protocol_session` (which reads as the ambient Cokret protocol) to `interop_session`, naming the external agent-to-agent interop relationship. Event kinds ck.{agent,applet}.protocol_session.* -> ck.{agent,applet}.interop_session.*; the agent capability action namespace ck.agent.session.* (start/cancel/stream_status/attach_artifact/read_transcript) -> ck.agent.interop_session.*; the typed id and schema payload defs use the agent_interop_session_* / applet_interop_session_* short form. Single design decision.
migration_group_definitions.conformance_verifier_neutralization: ServiceDescribe.verified_profiles neutralized away from the downstream tool name cotest: claim_kind enum value cotest_verified → conformance_verified, wire fields cotest_run_id → verification_run_id and cotest_issuer_did → verifier_did. The wire contract binds to the neutral Conformance Verifier role (conformance-suite.md §6.2); cotest survives only as an informative reference-implementation name in prose (3 entries).
migration_group_definitions.cba_notary_seal_rename: CBA terminology family rename (2026-06-11): the Anchor/Anchorer word family is replaced by Seal/Notary across wire fields, typed-id prefixes, cell families, enum values and model names; the Seal cumulative-coverage frontier[] enumeration is retired in favor of predecessor_refs + delta recursion (no direct field successor; the snapshot manifest's boundary `frontier` object and the streaming `frontier` frame kind are true-frontier semantics and keep their names); proposal-era interim spellings (governance_ref, Checkpoint) are forbidden. See authz/event-auth-state-resolution.md and overview/glossary.md.
